title: The Great Shaman of the Golden Clan
summary: Gui Li and Xiao Bai reach Qili Village, which Xiao Bai remembers as violent 300 years ago but which is now peaceful. She says the person she once saw perform a soul-return technique was the Golden Clan's Great Shaman. Xiao Bai points at the sacred altar, which is a grave insult, and villagers try to seize them until the chief, Tu Ma Gu, steps in. Gui Li tells him a friend has lain unconscious for ten years with her soul damaged, and Tu Ma Gu takes the request to the Great Shaman. Meanwhile Xiao Bai drinks the village men under the table. The Great Shaman, who hasn't left the altar in 100 years, agrees to see them when he hears only one soul of three and one spirit of seven remains. Gui Li explains that Bi Yao spent her life blocking the Zhu Xian Sword for him and that a trace of her soul is held in the Hehuan Bell. The Great Shaman says he knows something of the technique but first wants to know who told them about it. At Fen Xiang Valley, Shangguan Ce thanks the Qingyun and Tian Yin guests, says Yun Yilan is in seclusion, and blames the Demon Sect for using the eruption to attack. Lu Xueqi says she and Li Xun heard the demon cultists mention Qili Village, and the guests decide to go and investigate.
events: Gui Li and Xiao Bai arrive at Qili Village
